deviations: self-check-C8 reading: the route gate reads past a leading './' at the start of a token. C8 lists slash among the characters that stop a match, but './tmp/x' is the same path token as 'tmp/x'. Only a leading './' counts: 'x/./tmp' and '../tmp' still draw nothing. The verifier called this the owner's call; the stricter reading is implemented and tested, and can be reverted in one line if the owner prefers C8 as written.
